truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 identified 9 of 20 true vulnerabilities, partially identified 2, and missed 9. It also included 2 unsupported findings not in the ground truth. Key misses include critical issues: Use-After-Free in memory pool cleanup (SC-V3-003), Logic Bomb in authentication (SC-V3-007), Integer Underflow in block split (SC-V3-016), and Unbounded Recursion in parser (SC-V3-017). Two findings (Sandboxing Disabled, admin exec command injection) were supported by source but absent from the true vulnerability set.

Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the format-string injection in log_debug_message with exact code quote matching anchors log_format, runtime_log_format, and printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input). CWE-134 and Critical severity both match.
Run 2 did not identify the integer overflow in the factorial computation (result *= i with long long at lines 315-318). No finding references fact, result *= i, or integer overflow in factorial.

Run 2 did not identify the use-after-free in stage_deferred_history_flush where scratch allocated from g_memory_pool is captured by a lambda that sleeps, then cleanup() calls g_memory_pool.cleanup() freeing all blocks. No finding references stage_deferred_history_flush, g_memory_pool.cleanup, or use-after-free.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: std::string validator_cmd = get_setting("validator_path", "/usr/bin/validator"); std::string config_file = get_setting("config_file", "default.conf"); std::string command = validator_cmd + " " + config_file; int result = system(command.c_str());
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified command injection via validate_config with exact quote matching anchors validator_cmd + config_file and system(command.c_str()). CWE-78 matches; severity listed as High vs Critical but the vulnerability is fully present.

Run 2 correctly identified the stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression where strcpy is used unconditionally when expression.length() >= sizeof(input_buffer_). Matches anchors strcpy(input_buffer_) and the logic error of using strcpy for oversized input.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: long long old_value = value_; std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_); value_ = old_value + 1;
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the race condition in ThreadSafeCounter::increment where value_ is read before acquiring the lock. Matches anchors volatile long long (source uses volatile long long), old_value = value_, lock_guard, and value_ = old_value + 1.

Run 2 did not identify the logic bomb in authentication where login_attempts_ > 5 combined with EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE in the input string grants authenticated_ = true without proper credential verification. No finding references login_attempts_ > 5, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE, or logic bomb.

Run 2 did not identify path traversal in ConfigLoader::load_config where config_dir_ + filename is passed to filesystem::exists without sanitization. No finding references path traversal or config_dir_ + filename.

Run 2 correctly identified the heap overflow in ExpressionParser::parse where buffer_size_ is 256 but expr_str can exceed this (MAX_EXPRESSION_LENGTH is 2048). Matches anchors buffer_size_ = 256 and strcpy(expression_buffer_, ...).
Run 2 correctly identified hardcoded admin credentials with exact quote matching anchors ADMIN_SECRET and SC_ENT_2025_AUTH. CWE-798 and High severity both match.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: std::random_device rd; std::mt19937 gen(rd()); std::uniform_int_distribution<> dis(1000, 9999); return "TOKEN_" + std::to_string(dis(gen));
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified weak session token generation with correct code quote matching anchors std::mt19937, uniform_int_distribution, 1000, 9999. However, CWE was classified as CWE-330 instead of CWE-338. The vulnerability itself is correctly identified.

Run 2 did not identify the thread-unsafe timestamp cache where static std::tm cached_time is populated by localtime() without synchronization. No finding references static std::tm cached_time or localtime thread-unsafe usage.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: const char* temp_dir = std::getenv("TEMP"); std::string audit_path = std::string(temp_dir ? temp_dir : ".") + "\\supercalc_emergency.log"; std::string command = "cmd /C echo Admin override logged >> " + audit_path;
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the insecure temp file handling code path with correct quote matching anchors TEMP, TMPDIR (found in else branch), supercalc_emergency.log, and system(command.c_str()). However, CWE was classified as CWE-78 (command injection) instead of CWE-377 (insecure temporary file). The finding discusses TEMP env var control but misclassifies the primary vulnerability.

Run 2 did not identify persistent authentication state where authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ persist across operations without proper session invalidation. No finding references persistent auth state or CWE-613.

Run 2 did not identify unhandled exception in handle_variable_command where std::stod(tokens[3]) can throw if tokens[3] is not a valid number. No finding references std::stod(tokens[3]) or unhandled exception in variable parsing.

Run 2 did not identify integer underflow in MemoryPool::allocate where previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES can underflow if previous_size < size + SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES. No finding references SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES, previous_size, or integer underflow in block split.

Run 2 did not identify unbounded recursion in parser where parse_expression calls parse_factor which calls parse_expression on PAREN_OPEN without depth limit enforcement. No finding references unbounded recursion, parse_expression, or PAREN_OPEN recursion.

Run 2 did not identify data race in result_cache_ where evaluate_cached accesses result_cache_ without holding cache_mutex_, while thread_pool_->enqueue may concurrently access it. No finding references result_cache_ race or evaluate_cached concurrency issue.

Run 2 did not identify TOCTOU in ConfigLoader::load_config where std::filesystem::exists is called, then sleep_for(25ms), then std::ifstream opens the file — allowing race between check and open. No finding references TOCTOU, filesystem::exists, or sleep_for race.

Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified division by zero in calculate_route_score with exact quote matching anchors calculate_route_score, token_length, and 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length). CWE-369 and Low severity both match.
